about: FOR HONOR sounds read from the player's own install. wem_ids must be picked from the user's copy (run FHDuels with FHDUELS_DUMP_INDEX=1 to list them). When FOR HONOR can't supply a row (missing or encrypted packs), skyrim_match picks files from the game's own Skyrim - Sounds.bsa: every '|'-separated part must appear in the lowercase path ('/' separators). Empty means no fallback.
